nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land use planning|Land use efficiency measures_qna_000
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: Why are more intrusive instruments like taxes and regulatory measures considered more effective for achieving substantial progress in sustainability?
nodes.answer: These instruments, such as market-based measures or regulatory elimination of polluting products, are more effective in driving substantial and lasting progress towards sustainability compared to information-based instruments.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land use planning|Land use efficiency measures_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What indicators were evaluated in the study to assess ecosystem services in cropping systems?
nodes.answer: The indicators included crop productivity, resource use efficiency, soil carbon, economic returns, and environmental impacts.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land use planning|Land use efficiency measures_qna_002
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How did Go et al. calculate the embodied cultivated land use in China from 1987 to 2007?
nodes.answer: Go et al. calculated the embodied cultivated land use in China from 1987 to 2007 by analysing the amount of land required to produce goods and services consumed within that time period.
